ticket.title: Ticket
ticket.description: A GitHub issue such as acme/payments#42

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: The branch to build on and open the pull request against (for example dev)

def.description: Read the ticket from GitHub.
Read the GitHub issue and its first comments.
Turn the GitHub issue into one plain ticket (key, title, description).
Name the change (kebab-case, built only from [a-z0-9-]) and its change and archive folders.
Read openspec/ on the base branch - capabilities, exact requirement names, active changes and project rules (openspec-format skill).
Write the change - proposal, delta specs, tasks and optional design - and, when the repository has no openspec/ folder, its skeleton (openspec-format and delta-specs skills).
Validate the change the way `openspec validate --strict` does and against the requirement names the scan read.
Review a change that passes the check; give a failing one one fix round.
The first proposal passed the check.
Write the change again from a clean checkout, using the first attempt's files as a draft and fixing what the check reported (one round).

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'change_id': nodes.change_id.output.id, 'change_dir': nodes.change_id.output.change_dir, 'scan': nodes.scan.output, 'feedback': {'errors': nodes.check_1.output.errors, 'warnings': nodes.check_1.output.warnings, 'previous_files': nodes.propose.output.workspace.files.filter(f, f.status != 'deleted' && f.path != 'openspec/config.yaml').map(f, {'path': f.path, 'content': f.content})}}

def.description: Check the revised change.
Continue with a revised change that passes; send back one that still fails.
The revised proposal passed the check.
The errors the revised change still has.
Say the specs could not be made valid, instead of building from them.
The proposal round that passed the check.

input.map: {'first': has(nodes.pass_1) ? nodes.propose.output : null, 'revised': has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.revise.output : null}

def.description: Review only when a round passed the check; otherwise the run has already said why it stopped.
An independent review of the specs - testable, covered, in scope, consistent (spec-review skill, a different model from the author).

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'change_dir': nodes.change_id.output.change_dir, 'check': has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.check_2.output : nodes.check_1.output, 'conflicts': nodes.spec_change.output.conflicts, 'open_questions': nodes.spec_change.output.open_questions}

def.description: A person approves the specs before any code is written - the gate OpenSpec only has by convention.

message.cel: 'Approve the OpenSpec change ' + nodes.change_id.output.id + ' for ' + nodes.intake.output.key + '? ' + nodes.spec_review.output.summary + (nodes.spec_review.output.approved ? '' : ' The reviewer found a BLOCKING problem.') + (nodes.spec_review.output.prompt_injection_detected ? ' WARNING: the reviewer saw a prompt injection attempt.' : '') + (size(nodes.spec_change.output.open_questions) > 0 ? ' Answer the open questions in the notes.' : '')

payload.map: {'change_id': nodes.change_id.output.id, 'summary': nodes.spec_change.output.summary, 'deltas': has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.check_2.output.deltas : nodes.check_1.output.deltas, 'warnings': has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.check_2.output.warnings : nodes.check_1.output.warnings, 'open_questions': nodes.spec_change.output.open_questions, 'conflicts': nodes.spec_change.output.conflicts, 'review': nodes.spec_review.output, 'files': nodes.spec_change.output.workspace.files.map(f, f.path), 'diff': nodes.spec_change.output.workspace.diff}

notes.title: Answers and notes for the engineer
notes.description: One answer per open question, or: use the recommended defaults

def.description: Build the tasks in order, one test per scenario, tick them when done (implement-from-specs skill). The worker runs the tests after it submits and sends failures back.

test.command: node -e "process.env.AZHI_TEST_DATABASE_URL='pglite://';require('child_process').execSync('npm ci && npm run typecheck && npx vitest run',{stdio:'inherit',env:process.env})"

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'change_id': nodes.change_id.output.id, 'change_dir': nodes.change_id.output.change_dir, 'deltas': has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.check_2.output.deltas : nodes.check_1.output.deltas, 'decisions': nodes.proposal_approval.output.data}

def.description: Check the code against every requirement and scenario - completeness, correctness, coherence (spec-verify skill, advisory).

input.map: {'change_dir': nodes.change_id.output.change_dir, 'deltas': has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.check_2.output.deltas : nodes.check_1.output.deltas, 'change': {'summary': nodes.apply.output.summary, 'deviations': nodes.apply.output.deviations, 'tests_added': nodes.apply.output.tests_added, 'stats': nodes.apply.output.workspace.stats, 'tests': nodes.apply.output.workspace.tests, 'diff': nodes.apply.output.workspace.diff}}

def.description: Ask for release only when the tests passed; otherwise send the change back.
Why the change was not released.

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'stage': 'build', 'errors': ['The tests did not pass after ' + string(nodes.apply.output.workspace.tests.attempts) + ' attempt(s): ' + nodes.apply.output.workspace.tests.status], 'warnings': []}

def.description: Say the build failed its tests instead of asking for release.
The release owner approves the exact change, the verification report and the spec merge before anything is archived or pushed.

message.cel: 'Archive ' + nodes.change_id.output.id + ' into openspec/specs/, push ' + string(nodes.apply.output.workspace.stats.files) + ' changed file(s) for ' + nodes.intake.output.key + ' to ' + inputs.repo + ' and open a pull request? Tests ' + nodes.apply.output.workspace.tests.status + '. ' + nodes.verify.output.summary + (nodes.verify.output.issues.exists(i, i.level == 'CRITICAL') ? ' WARNING: the verifier found CRITICAL issues, so the pull request opens as a draft.' : '')

payload.map: {'repository': inputs.repo, 'branch': 'azhi/' + nodes.intake.output.key, 'change_id': nodes.change_id.output.id, 'archive_dir': nodes.change_id.output.archive_dir, 'stats': nodes.apply.output.workspace.stats, 'tests': nodes.apply.output.workspace.tests, 'diff': nodes.apply.output.workspace.diff, 'verification': nodes.verify.output, 'deviations': nodes.apply.output.deviations}

def.description: Merge the delta specs into openspec/specs/ and move the change folder to the dated archive folder (spec-archive skill). A script checks the result.

input.map: {'change_id': nodes.change_id.output.id, 'change_dir': nodes.change_id.output.change_dir, 'archive_dir': nodes.change_id.output.archive_dir, 'deltas': has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.check_2.output.deltas : nodes.check_1.output.deltas}

def.description: Check the archive as postconditions - every delta is in the merged spec, the folder moved unchanged, and no code or other spec changed.
Push only an archive the check accepts.
What is wrong with the archive.
Say the archive failed its check, instead of pushing it.
Commit the change, with the merged specs and the archived folder, onto the base commit and push it as an azhi/ branch (Git Data API).
Open a pull request for the branch (a draft when the tests did not pass or the verifier found a critical issue), or return the one already open.

body.cel:
nodes.apply.output.pr_body + '

## OpenSpec
Change `' + nodes.change_id.output.id + '` archived at `' + nodes.change_id.output.archive_dir + '`. ' + nodes.verify.output.summary + '

Approved for push by ' + nodes.release_approval.output.by + '. Ticket: ' + nodes.intake.output.key + ' ' + nodes.intake.output.url + '

_Opened by Azhi Flow (openspec-flow) after a person approved the specs and the release._'

def.description: Announce the pull request.

message.cel: 'Pull request for ' + nodes.intake.output.key + ': ' + nodes.open_pr.output.url + ' (' + nodes.apply.output.summary + '; OpenSpec change ' + nodes.change_id.output.id + ' archived)'

def.description: Write the delivery record - specs, review, tests and verification.

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'change': nodes.change_id.output, 'deltas': (has(nodes.pass_2) ? nodes.check_2.output.deltas : nodes.check_1.output.deltas), 'proposal_by': nodes.proposal_approval.output.by, 'release_by': nodes.release_approval.output.by, 'review': nodes.spec_review.output, 'apply': nodes.apply.output, 'verify': nodes.verify.output, 'branch': nodes.push_branch.output, 'pr': nodes.open_pr.output}
